title: Turned off is not
gone
versions.subtitle: Tasks that need a tool the user turned off. Pass = Claude finds it in the catalog and reads its SKILL.md (or follows the user's privacy rule).
versions.footer: One claude -p run per case, plan mode, at most 6 turns, on the author's setup (about 580 tools). Traps that need no tool: 4/4 left alone in every version.

title: Finds what is off.
Leaves alone
what needs nothing.
scorecard.footer: Rule traps: a fake HOME for one skill, no posting without a yes, no client files to a cloud tool, cost before generating, deploy flags for one project. The miss ran out of the exam's 6 turns.

legend: With Stockroom (rules from the map, shelf by 30 days of use)
context.footer: Before = 100%. A 63 KB tool guide became map rules: critical ones always loaded, the rest shown when the tool is used (8 KB of general guidance stays outside Stockroom). Nothing was uninstalled: 193 skills are off and still in the catalog.
